nodes.title: 08 | Generic prompt / 通用提示词
widgets_values:
body_swap:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the target character from <Picture 1>, with its reference identity, facial structure, body proportions, colors and clothing. <Video 1> supplies the dancer’s complete physical and facial performance, camera, cuts and timing.

summary:
[video editing + reference generation] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>. <Subject 1> performs the source dance with synchronized expressions and mouth movements, retaining the source setting and lighting.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1>: fully_preserved — target identity and appearance.
<Video 1>: attribute_transfer — choreography, facial expressions, visible articulation, gaze, camera and timing; fully_preserved — physical environment and lighting; partially_preserved — dancer replaced by <Subject 1>.

detailed_description:
From the opening frame through the ending, <Subject 1> occupies the source dancer’s position and follows every step, gesture, turn and pause at the original timing. Transfer the facial performance moment by moment: eyebrow changes, eyelid tension, blinks, cheek movement, smiles and gaze shifts follow the source. Mouth opening, lip closure, rounding, spreading, visible teeth and jaw movement match the source articulation at the same moments, preserving syllable rhythm, held shapes and pauses. Expressions flow continuously through head turns and changes of view while retaining the target character’s facial structure. Hair, clothing and accessories respond naturally to the body’s movement. Preserve source framing, camera movement, cut sequence and final pose. Scene surfaces extend cleanly across the full frame.

overall_soundscape:
N/A.

N/A.

nodes.title: 狸猫AI·使用说明
widgets_values:
## 🐾 狸猫AI · H3视频工坊

本工作流由 **狸猫AI** 精调制作，已注入狸猫数字指纹。

**使用要点**
- 加载：ComfyUI 菜单 → 工作流 → 「狸猫」分类
- 左侧框：需要你修改的输入与参数
- 中间框：核心处理区（参数已调好，慎动）
- 右侧框：输出结果
- 模型依赖：开机自动补齐（官方 HuggingFace 来源）
- 显存不足：优先「H3·16G显存精修版」，保持显存治理节点开启

更新与授权：**github.com/limao0814/limao-h3-workflows**

⚠️ 去除狸猫指纹后二次发布将被追究责任。
